snippet.title: Strife Project Beta v3 Trailer (Jade + Karkat) [SAHCon 2024 New Years]
snippet.description:
As seen on the SAHCon 2024 New Years showcase! Jade Harley and Karkat Vantas coming soon in the Beta v3 update!!

More info + Beta v2 Download (December 2022): https://wiiuski.itch.io/strife-project
Join our Discord for help, feedback, and questions: https://discord.gg/k4XTNKZ
